Quantum 1.29.0 was certified on 2026-09-08. It pins **nucleus v1.25.0**, **quark v1.12.0** and **orbit v1.9.3**, with 22 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.28.0: nucleus goes from v1.24.0 to v1.25.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.11.0 to v1.12.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.9.2 to v1.9.3 (patch). 21 sibling modules change version.
